lesson.title: Day 6: Colleague conversation — SpeakSprint
lesson.heading: Colleague conversation
lesson.description: Phản xạ trong hội thoại với đồng nghiệp.

sections.html:
MISSION · 1 MIN

Today's mission

Role-play both sides of a short conversation about a task. Speak for 90–120 seconds, using at least 3 of today’s 5 chunks. Say it first; write only brief notes.

5 chunk mỗi ngày · tối đa 5 chunk mới. Ngày tổng kết ôn lại chunk đã học.

RECALL · 3 MIN

Warm-up recall

Recall before opening today’s chunk cards. Ôn theo mốc bài học +1, +3, +7, +14; mỗi lần chọn vài chunk để giữ bài gọn.

Day 5 · ôn sau 1 bài

Explain which task is not finished yet. Say one sentence from memory.

Day 3 · ôn sau 3 bài

Tell someone when a task must be ready. Use it in a different project or situation.

Day 5 · ôn sau 1 bài

Report a task you finished yesterday. Say one sentence from memory.

INPUT · 4 MIN

Read, listen to your own voice, and notice

Read once for meaning. Then read aloud; on the second pass, notice how the speaker uses whole phrases.

Ana: How's it going? Is the new page ready?
Minh: It's almost ready. Yesterday, I finished the main screen. I'm still working on one test.
Ana: What's the problem?
Minh: I'm having trouble with the login feature. It works on my computer, but the mobile test fails. Could you help me with that test?
Ana: Sure. Let's look at it together after lunch.
Minh: Thanks. Right now, I'm checking the error message. I share test results with our team, so everyone can see the problem. The deadline is Friday, and this is the last thing we need to check.

sections.label: COMPREHENSION · 3 MIN
sections.heading: Check the message
sections.hint: Look for who, what happened, and why the speaker says it.

questions.prompt: 3. Why does Ana suggest looking together?

sections.label: CHUNKS · 5 MIN
sections.heading: Five chunks to use today
sections.instruction: Learn the whole phrase. Change the details to fit your work. Mở từng thẻ khi cần; sau đó nhìn đi chỗ khác và nói lại.

items.label: 1/5 · Luyện hôm nay
items.meaning: Dạo này công việc thế nào?
details: Start a friendly conversation about progress.
How's it going? + optional follow-up question
How's it going?
How's it going? Is the new page ready?

items.label: 2/5 · Luyện hôm nay
details: Tell a colleague that only a little work remains.
It's almost ready + optional remaining task
It's almost ready.
It's almost ready. I just need to run one test.

items.label: 3/5 · Luyện hôm nay
items.meaning: Tôi đang gặp khó khăn với…
details: Describe something you cannot do easily.
I'm having trouble with + noun / verb-ing
I'm having trouble with this test.
I'm having trouble with the login feature.

items.label: 4/5 · Luyện hôm nay
details: Ask politely for help with a task.
Could you help me with + noun / verb-ing + ?
Could you help me with this task?
Could you help me with testing the new page?

items.label: 5/5 · Luyện hôm nay
details: Suggest checking a problem together.
Let's look at it together + optional time
Let's look at it together.
Let's look at it together after lunch.

sections.html:
VARIATION · 4 MIN

Change it, then make it yours

Say each answer first, then type a short sentence. Two quick variations per chunk; keep the same pattern.

1. How's it going?

2. It's almost ready

3. I'm having trouble with…

4. Could you help me with…?

5. Let's look at it together

RAPID RECALL · 3 MIN

Recall in about three seconds

Look away from the chunk cards. Try to start speaking within 3 seconds, then type what you said. A model appears only after an attempt; other natural answers are possible.

Start a friendly conversation about progress. Say one sentence aloud.

Tell a colleague that only a little work remains. Say one sentence aloud.

Describe something you cannot do easily. Say one sentence aloud.

Ask politely for help with a task. Say one sentence aloud.

Suggest checking a problem together. Say one sentence aloud.

Name something that is stopping your progress. Say one sentence from memory.

SPEAK · 5 MIN

Make the language yours

Read aloud three times. Follow the pauses marked by / and emphasize the important words.

How's it going? /
It's almost ready. /
I'm having trouble with this test.

Speaking challenge: Role-play both sides of a short conversation about a task.

Speak for 90–120 seconds. Use at least 3 chunks. Notes only: your situation · two details · a reason or problem · your next step. Do not write a full script first.

Chưa hoàn thành

CONVERSATION · 3 MIN

A real work conversation

Practise with a partner, or take both roles aloud. Your partner is a coworker. Open one question, answer it, then continue. Khi luyện cùng Codex, yêu cầu đóng vai đồng nghiệp và hỏi từng câu; trang này không có AI trò chuyện trực tiếp.

Colleague · question 1

What do you do in your team?

Colleague · question 2

What are you working on now?

Colleague · question 3

What is difficult about it?

Colleague · question 4

What will you do next?

After 4 exchanges, choose at most 3 useful corrections. Say the improved sentences once more.

sections.label: END CHECK · 2 MIN
sections.heading: Choose a useful chunk
sections.hint: Think about the situation where you would use the phrase.

questions.prompt: 1. Start a friendly conversation about progress.

sections.html:
REVIEW · 2 MIN

Today's progress

Các số về nói và nhớ chunk là tự đánh giá; số câu đọc hiểu lấy từ lần nộp gần nhất. Chưa nhập nghĩa là chưa có dữ liệu.

lesson.completionText: Hoàn thành đọc hiểu, kể lần một, quiz và các bước Recall → Think → đối chiếu → kể lần hai. Nhiều bài trong cùng ngày chỉ tính một ngày streak.
